pyq_focus: Drama unit se NET har baar 8-12 sawal tak puchta hai, isliye ye sabse scoring unit hai.
Sabse zyada sawal author-work matching par aate hain: kaun sa play kisne likha (Jacobean, Restoration, American, Indian).
Chronology bahut aati hai: 4 plays ko saal ke order mein lagana. Har bade play ka saal yaad karo, kam se kam decade.
Characters se play pehchanna: Mosca, Bosola, Millamant, Mrs Malaprop, Jimmy Porter, Blanche, Willy Loman, Leela Benare.
Famous lines ka speaker aur play: Shakespeare, Webster, Congreve, Wilde, Beckett, Williams ki lines baar baar aati hain.
Terms aur unke coiner: catharsis, objective correlative, comedy of menace, Theatre of the Absurd, alienation effect, in-yer-face.
Assertion-Reason mein Aristotle, Brecht, Absurd theatre, sentimental comedy aur Licensing Act jaise topics aate hain.
Taiyari: pehle 'easy' story padho, phir works list aur people list ko flashcard ki tarah 3-4 baar dohrao, phir 100 MCQ lagao.
Indian drama (Karnad, Tendulkar, Sircar, Dattani) aur Nobel winner dramatists (Shaw, O'Neill, Beckett, Soyinka, Pinter) ko alag se pakka karo.

easy.title: Greek Tragedy and Aristotle's Poetics
easy.story: Socho purane Athens mein Dionysus devta ka bada mela lagta tha, bilkul hamari Ramlila jaisa. Wahan Aeschylus, Sophocles aur Euripides apne dukh bhare natak dikhate the. Hero bada aadmi hota tha, par ek galti (hamartia) ki wajah se gir jata tha, jaise Oedipus. Achanak kismat palat jati (peripeteia) aur hero ko sach pata chalta (anagnorisis). Dekhne wale ko daya aur dar mehsoos hota, phir dil halka ho jata - isko catharsis kehte hain. Aristotle ne Poetics mein ye sab niyam likh diye aur kaha ki plot natak ki aatma hai.
easy.trick: 'Aaj Sabko Exam' = Aeschylus, Sophocles, Euripides (purane se naye). Actor gino: Aeschylus ne 2nd actor joda, Sophocles ne 3rd - S matlab 'Sabse zyada' actors.

easy.title: Greek and Roman Comedy; Seneca
easy.story: Tragedy ke saath Greece mein hasi wale natak bhi the. Aristophanes bade netaon aur Socrates ka mazaak udate the, jaise aaj ke comedy shows. Baad mein Menander ne ghar-parivaar wali comedy likhi. Rome mein Plautus aur Terence ne yahi style apnayi, aur Shakespeare ne Plautus se Comedy of Errors banayi. Seneca ke natak khoon, bhoot aur badle se bhare the, jaise purani masala film. Elizabethan revenge tragedy isi Seneca se nikli.
easy.trick: 'Aristophanes = Aaj ki Satire' (Clouds mein Socrates ka mazaak). 'Plautus ke Twins = Comedy of Errors'. 'Seneca = Sirf Khoon aur Bhoot'.

easy.title: Medieval English Drama
easy.story: Purane England mein natak church se shuru hua, jaise mandir mein katha. Easter par 'Quem Quaeritis' (kise dhoondh rahe ho?) wala chhota sa dialogue gaya jata tha. Phir Bible ki kahaniyan gaon ke karigar (guilds) gaadiyon par dikhane lage - ye Mystery plays the. Morality plays mein achchai aur buraai insaan ban kar aate the, jaise Everyman mein Death, Good Deeds. Everyman ka saath maut tak sirf Good Deeds deta hai, dost aur paisa nahi. Phir Ralph Roister Doister aur Gorboduc se asli English comedy aur tragedy shuru hui.
easy.trick: 'Maut ke time sirf achhe karam saath jaate hain' = Everyman + Good Deeds. 'Ralph Roya, Gorboduc Gaya': pehli comedy (Udall) aur pehli blank verse tragedy (1561).

easy.title: University Wits, Kyd and Marlowe
easy.story: Shakespeare se pehle Oxford-Cambridge se padhe kuch hoshiyaar ladke London aaye aur natak likhne lage - inhe University Wits kehte hain. Inme sabse bada star Marlowe tha, jisne blank verse ko taaqatwar banaya. Uska Doctor Faustus apni aatma shaitan ko 24 saal ke liye bech deta hai, jaise koi shortcut ke liye sab kuch daav par laga de. Kyd ki The Spanish Tragedy ne badle wale natak ka trend shuru kiya. Greene ne jalan mein Shakespeare ko 'upstart crow' keh diya.
easy.trick: Wits ke naam: 'Lyly Peele Greene, Lodge Nashe Marlowe' - 'LPG Lo Na Mar'. Marlowe ke 4 hero: Tamburlaine, Faustus, Barabas, Edward - 'TFBE: Taaqat, Faustus, Bania, Edward'.

easy.title: Shakespeare
easy.story: Shakespeare English ke sabse bade natakkaar hain, jaise Hindi mein Premchand kahani ke. Unhone comedy, history, tragedy aur romance sab likhe. Char badi tragedies hain Hamlet, Othello, King Lear aur Macbeth - har hero ki ek kamzori use dubo deti hai. Unke marne ke baad 1623 mein dost Heminges aur Condell ne First Folio chhapa. Globe Theatre unka 'ghar' tha. Critics jaise Johnson, Coleridge, Bradley aur Eliot ne unpar bahut likha.
easy.trick: Badi 4 tragedies: 'HOLM' = Hamlet, Othello, Lear, Macbeth (likhne ka order bhi yahi). Last romances: 'Pehle Cymbal bajao, Winter mein Tempest' = Pericles, Cymbeline, Winter's Tale, Tempest.

easy.title: Jacobean and Caroline Drama
easy.story: James I ke time (Jacobean) ke natak andhere, khooni aur chalaak logon se bhare the. Ben Jonson ne 'humours' wali comedy likhi, jahan har kirdaar ek hi aadat ka gulaam hota hai, jaise koi sirf paise ka bhooka. Volpone mein sab kirdaaron ke naam jaanwaron par hain - lomdi, makkhi, giddh. Webster ki Duchess of Malfi ko uske hi bhai maarwa dete hain. Middleton, Ford, Tourneur ne bhi badle aur paap ke natak likhe. 1642 mein Puritans ne saare theatre band kar diye.
easy.trick: Volpone = 'Fox ka Zoo': Volpone fox, Mosca fly, Voltore vulture, Corbaccio raven, Corvino crow. 'Webster = Death ka Master' (skull beneath the skin).

easy.title: Restoration Drama (1660-1700)
easy.story: 1660 mein Charles II wapas aaye aur theatre phir se khul gaye, bilkul lockdown ke baad mall khulne jaisa. Ab pehli baar auraton ne stage par acting ki. Comedies mein London ke ameer, chalaak, flirt karne wale log the - isko comedy of manners kehte hain. Congreve ki The Way of the World mein Mirabell aur Millamant shaadi se pehle apni shartein (proviso scene) rakhte hain. Dryden ne heroic drama likha jisme pyaar aur izzat ki ladai hoti thi. 1698 mein Jeremy Collier ne in natakon ko gande keh kar attack kiya.
easy.trick: Comedy of manners ke 5: 'Every Wise Cat Visits Farms' = Etherege, Wycherley, Congreve, Vanbrugh, Farquhar. Collier 1698 = '98 mein Collier ne Chaar (charge) lagaya'.

easy.title: Eighteenth-Century Drama
easy.story: 18vi sadi mein log rona-dhona aur seekh wali 'sentimental comedy' pasand karne lage, jaise purani family TV serial. Goldsmith aur Sheridan ne iske khilaaf asli hasi wali 'laughing comedy' wapas laayi. She Stoops to Conquer mein Marlow ek ghar ko galti se hotel samajh leta hai. Sheridan ki Mrs Malaprop galat shabd bolti hai, isse 'malapropism' bana. John Gay ki The Beggar's Opera chor-dakuon ke gaanon wala natak tha. Fielding ke tikhe natakon se 1737 ka Licensing Act aaya aur censorship shuru hui.
easy.trick: 'Sheridan ke 3 S': Scandal (School for Scandal), Sneerwell, Surface brothers. 'Goldsmith ne 1773 mein Stoop kiya' = She Stoops to Conquer + Essay on the Theatre, dono 1773.

easy.title: Nineteenth-Century Drama: Romantics to Wilde and Shaw
easy.story: Romantic kavi (Shelley, Byron) ne natak likhe par ye padhne layak zyada the, stage ke kam - closet drama. Stage par melodrama ka raaj tha, jaise purani Bollywood masala. Phir Oscar Wilde aaye, jinke natak chatpate jumlon se bhare the - The Importance of Being Earnest sabse mashhoor. Bernard Shaw ne Ibsen se seekh kar samaaj ki buraiyon par sawaal uthaye, jaise paisa, garibi, aurat ki haalat. Pygmalion mein Professor Higgins phool bechne wali Eliza ko 'lady' banata hai. Shaw ko 1925 mein Nobel mila.
easy.trick: Wilde ke 4 comedies 'Lady Woman Ideal Earnest' (Fan 1892 se Earnest 1895). Shaw ka 'P.S.' = Pygmalion 1913, Saint Joan 1923 - dono ke beech 10 saal.

easy.title: Modern and Contemporary British Drama
easy.story: 20vi sadi mein T. S. Eliot ne kavita wale natak wapas laaye, jaise Murder in the Cathedral. 1956 mein Osborne ka Look Back in Anger aaya - Jimmy Porter gussa karne wala naujawan, jaise berozgar beta ghar mein sab par chilla raha ho. Pinter ke natakon mein chupi dhamki aur lambe pause hote hain - comedy of menace. Stoppard ne Hamlet ke do chhote kirdaaron ko hero bana diya. Caryl Churchill ne aurat aur paise ke sawaal uthaye. 1990s mein Sarah Kane jaise lekhakon ka 'in-yer-face' theatre aaya.
easy.trick: '8 May 1956 = Angry Day' (Look Back in Anger). Pinter ke 'B-C-H-B': Birthday Party, Caretaker, Homecoming, Betrayal - order mein.

easy.title: Irish Drama
easy.story: Ireland ne apni pehchaan dikhane ke liye apna theatre banaya - Abbey Theatre, Dublin (1904). Yeats, Lady Gregory aur Synge iske neta the. Synge ke Riders to the Sea mein ek maa Maurya ke saare bete samundar le leta hai. Playboy of the Western World par 1907 mein dange ho gaye. O'Casey ne Dublin ke gareeb logon ki teen kahaniyan likhi. Beckett bhi Irish the, aur Brian Friel ne Translations mein bhasha aur angrezi raaj ka dard dikhaya.
easy.trick: O'Casey trilogy 'Gun-Juno-Plough' = 1923-24-26. 'Synge ka Sea aur Playboy: 1904 mein rona, 1907 mein danga'.

easy.title: American Drama
easy.story: America ka asli natak Eugene O'Neill se shuru hua, jinhe 1936 mein Nobel mila. Tennessee Williams ne toote sapno wale logon ki kahani likhi - Blanche aur Laura jaise naazuk kirdaar. Arthur Miller ka Willy Loman ek salesman hai jo 'success' ke peeche bhaagte bhaagte toot jata hai, jaise EMI mein phansa aam aadmi. The Crucible mein chudailon ke jhoothe case dikha kar McCarthy ke daur par chot ki. Albee, Hansberry, August Wilson ne parivaar, nasl aur sapnon ki baat ki.
easy.trick: 'Miller ke 3 = All Death Crucible' (1947, 1949, 1953). Williams = 'Glass todo, Streetcar pakdo, Cat ko chhat par bithao' (1944, 1947, 1955).

easy.title: Theatre of the Absurd
easy.story: Do world wars ke baad logon ko laga zindagi ka koi matlab hi nahi. Absurd theatre yahi dikhata hai: kahani aage nahi badhti, baatein bekaar lagti hain. Waiting for Godot mein do aadmi ek ped ke paas Godot ka intezaar karte hain jo kabhi nahi aata, jaise bus stop par aisi bus ka intezaar jo route par hai hi nahi. Ionesco ke Rhinoceros mein sab log gainda ban jaate hain. Martin Esslin ne 1961 mein is theatre ko ye naam diya. Iski philosophy Camus ki Myth of Sisyphus se aati hai.
easy.trick: Godot ke log 'V-E-P-L': Vladimir, Estragon, Pozzo, Lucky. Endgame mein 'Hamm aur Clov, mummy-papa dustbin mein' (Nagg, Nell).

easy.title: European and World Drama
easy.story: Norway ke Ibsen ko modern drama ka pita kehte hain - A Doll's House mein Nora darwaza patak kar ghar chhod deti hai. Strindberg aur Chekhov ne mann ke andar ki ulajhan dikhayi. Chekhov ki Cherry Orchard mein ek purana parivaar apna baag kho deta hai, jaise purani haveli bik jaye. Brecht chahta tha ki darshak roye nahi, sochein - isliye epic theatre aur alienation effect. Africa se Soyinka aur Fugard, Caribbean se Walcott ne apni zameen ki kahaniyan di.
easy.trick: Ibsen ka order 'Peer, Doll, Ghost, Duck, Hedda' (1867-1890). Chekhov ke 4: 'Seagull Uncle ki Teen Behnon ka Cherry Orchard'.

easy.title: Indian Drama (Classical and Indian English)
easy.story: Bharat mein natak bahut purana hai - Bharata ka Natyashastra rasa theory deta hai, jaise khane ke swaad ki tarah natak ke bhi 'ras' hote hain. Kalidasa ka Shakuntala duniya bhar mein mashhoor hua jab William Jones ne 1789 mein uska anuvaad kiya. Aaj ke daur mein Karnad ne itihas aur lok-kathaon se Tughlaq aur Hayavadana likhe. Tendulkar ne Marathi mein samaaj ki hinsa dikhayi, Badal Sircar ne sadak par 'Third Theatre' kiya. Mahesh Dattani ne English mein ghar-parivaar aur gender ke chhupe sawal uthaye.
easy.trick: Karnad ka order 'Y-T-H-N' = Yayati 1961, Tughlaq 1964, Hayavadana 1971, Naga-Mandala 1988 - 'Yaar Tum Hamesha Nach'te ho'. Dattani = 'Dance, Tara, Final' (1989-90-93).

easy.title: Dramatic Theory and Criticism
easy.story: Natak kaise likha aur dekha jaye, is par bahut se logon ne niyam banaye. Sidney aur baad ke classical log 'unities' (ek kahani, ek jagah, ek din) chahte the. Dryden ne apne essay mein char doston ki bahas dikhayi, aur Johnson ne kaha darshak bewakoof nahi hain, wo jaante hain stage sirf stage hai. Freytag ne kahani ka pyramid banaya, jaise pahad par chadhna aur utarna. 20vi sadi mein Artaud, Grotowski, Brook aur Boal ne naye theatre ke ideas diye.
easy.trick: 'Artaud = Atyachar (Cruelty), Grotowski = Gareeb (Poor), Brook = Bare Khali Space (Empty Space), Boal = Bechare Oppressed'.

quotes.quote: Tragedy, then, is an imitation of an action that is serious, complete, and of a certain magnitude ... through pity and fear effecting the proper purgation of these emotions.
The plot, then, is the first principle, and, as it were, the soul of a tragedy.
Was this the face that launched a thousand ships, / And burnt the topless towers of Ilium?
Why, this is hell, nor am I out of it.
To be, or not to be: that is the question.
Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.
The readiness is all.
O, beware, my lord, of jealousy; / It is the green-eyed monster which doth mock / The meat it feeds on.
As flies to wanton boys are we to the gods; / They kill us for their sport.
Ripeness is all.
Fair is foul, and foul is fair.
Tomorrow, and tomorrow, and tomorrow, / Creeps in this petty pace from day to day.
All the world's a stage, / And all the men and women merely players.
quotes.source: As You Like It, Act II, c. 1599

quotes.quote: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon 'em.
quotes.by: William Shakespeare (Malvolio reading Maria's forged letter)

quotes.quote: The course of true love never did run smooth.
quotes.source: A Midsummer Night's Dream, Act I, c. 1595

quotes.quote: We are such stuff / As dreams are made on, and our little life / Is rounded with a sleep.
He was not of an age, but for all time!
quotes.source: To the Memory of My Beloved, the Author Mr William Shakespeare, First Folio, 1623

quotes.quote: Thou hadst small Latin and less Greek.
Cover her face; mine eyes dazzle: she died young.
I am Duchess of Malfi still.
He was the man who of all modern, and perhaps ancient poets, had the largest and most comprehensive soul.
I admire him, but I love Shakespeare.
Music has charms to soothe a savage breast.
Heaven has no rage like love to hatred turned, / Nor hell a fury like a woman scorned.
I may by degrees dwindle into a wife.
quotes.source: The Way of the World, 1700, Act IV

quotes.quote: He is the very pineapple of politeness!
Shakespeare is above all writers, at least above all modern writers, the poet of nature.
The motive-hunting of a motiveless malignity.
To lose one parent, Mr Worthing, may be regarded as a misfortune; to lose both looks like carelessness.
The truth is rarely pure and never simple.
He who can, does. He who cannot, teaches.
The last temptation is the greatest treason: / To do the right deed for the wrong reason.
Human kind cannot bear very much reality.
The only way of expressing emotion in the form of art is by finding an 'objective correlative'.
There aren't any good, brave causes left.
They're all gone now, and there isn't anything more the sea can do to me.
The whole worl's in a terrible state o' chassis.
Nothing to be done.
A play in which nothing happens, twice.
Finished, it's finished, nearly finished, it must be nearly finished.
I give you truth in the pleasant disguise of illusion.
I have always depended on the kindness of strangers.
Attention must be paid to such a person.
I believe that the common man is as apt a subject for tragedy in its highest sense as kings were.
Hell is other people.
Unhappy the land that is in need of heroes.
I can take any empty space and call it a bare stage.
Webster was much possessed by death / And saw the skull beneath the skin.
Mongrel tragicomedy.
quotes.by: Philip Sidney (on plays that mingle kings and clowns)

mcqs.q: The Spanish Tragedy, the model Elizabethan revenge play, was written by:
mcqs.exp: Thomas Kyd ne c. 1587 mein likha; Hieronimo ka badla, play-within-play.

mcqs.q: Which play is generally regarded as the first regular English comedy?
mcqs.exp: Nicholas Udall ka Ralph Roister Doister (c. 1552), Plautus ke model par.

mcqs.q: Bosola, the hired spy and malcontent, is a character in:
mcqs.exp: Webster ki The Duchess of Malfi mein Bosola Ferdinand ka jasoos hai.

mcqs.q: Mosca, the cunning parasite servant, appears in Ben Jonson's:
mcqs.exp: Volpone mein Mosca (makkhi) Volpone (lomdi) ka naukar hai.

mcqs.q: The Shoemaker's Holiday (1599), a city comedy about Simon Eyre, is by:
mcqs.exp: Thomas Dekker; Simon Eyre mochi se London ka Lord Mayor banta hai.

mcqs.q: Sir Giles Overreach is the villain of A New Way to Pay Old Debts, written by:
mcqs.exp: Philip Massinger ka Caroline-era comedy, Overreach lalchi villain.

mcqs.q: Malvolio, the steward cross-gartered in yellow stockings, belongs to:
mcqs.exp: Twelfth Night mein Olivia ka steward Malvolio ka mazaak udaya jata hai.

mcqs.q: Which of these characters appears in Sheridan's The School for Scandal?
mcqs.exp: Lady Teazle (Sir Peter ki wife); Bracknell Wilde, Wishfort Congreve, Hardcastle Goldsmith.

mcqs.q: Goldsmith's She Stoops to Conquer (1773) carries the subtitle:
options: A Bold Stroke for a Wife
mcqs.exp: Poora title: She Stoops to Conquer, or The Mistakes of a Night.

mcqs.q: Horner, who spreads a rumour of his own impotence, is the hero of:
mcqs.exp: Wycherley ki The Country Wife (1675), famous 'china scene'.

mcqs.q: Sir Fopling Flutter, the archetypal Restoration fop, appears in Etherege's:
mcqs.exp: The Man of Mode (1676); hero Dorimant, fop Sir Fopling Flutter.

mcqs.q: Dryden's All for Love (1677) retells the story of:
mcqs.exp: All for Love, or The World Well Lost: Antony-Cleopatra, unities ke saath blank verse mein.

mcqs.q: George Lillo's The London Merchant (1731) is a landmark of:
mcqs.exp: Apprentice George Barnwell ki kahani; aam middle-class tragedy.

mcqs.q: The Cenci (1819), a verse tragedy of incest and murder, was written by:
mcqs.exp: Shelley ki Romantic closet drama; Beatrice Cenci apne pita ko marwati hai.

mcqs.q: Which Wilde play is subtitled 'A Trivial Comedy for Serious People'?
mcqs.exp: The Importance of Being Earnest (1895), Jack-Algernon, Lady Bracknell.

mcqs.q: Mrs Warren's Profession belongs to Shaw's collection:
mcqs.exp: Plays Unpleasant (1898): Widowers' Houses, The Philanderer, Mrs Warren's Profession.

mcqs.q: In Look Back in Anger, Jimmy Porter's wife is:
mcqs.exp: Alison Porter; Helena uski saheli. Ruth Homecoming ki, Stella Streetcar ki.

mcqs.q: Stanley Webber, visited by the sinister Goldberg and McCann, is the central figure of Pinter's:
mcqs.exp: The Birthday Party (1958), comedy of menace ka classic.

mcqs.q: Stoppard's Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead (1966) is built around:
mcqs.exp: Hamlet ke do chhote dost main characters ban jate hain.

mcqs.q: Riders to the Sea (1904), in which Maurya loses all her sons to the sea, was written by:
mcqs.exp: Synge ka one-act play, Aran Islands par set.

mcqs.q: The Abbey Theatre, Dublin, opened in 1904 under the leadership of:
options: G. B. Shaw and Oscar Wilde
W. B. Yeats and Lady Gregory
mcqs.exp: Yeats aur Lady Gregory Irish Literary Revival ke national theatre ke founders.

mcqs.q: Amanda, Laura and Tom Wingfield are characters in:
options: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
mcqs.exp: Tennessee Williams ka 'memory play' (1944); Tom narrator hai.

mcqs.q: Arthur Miller's The Crucible (1953) is set during:
mcqs.exp: Salem witch trials; McCarthyism ka allegory.

mcqs.q: The quarrelling couple at the centre of Albee's Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? are:
mcqs.exp: George aur Martha, mehmaan Nick aur Honey.

mcqs.q: Brutus Jones, who flees into the forest as his fears take shape, is the protagonist of O'Neill's:
mcqs.exp: The Emperor Jones (1920), expressionist play.

mcqs.q: 'Marlowe's mighty line' was praised in a famous poem by:
mcqs.exp: Jonson ki Shakespeare par First Folio (1623) wali poem mein.

mcqs.q: The title A Raisin in the Sun (1959) is taken from a poem by:
mcqs.exp: Langston Hughes ki 'Harlem': 'What happens to a dream deferred?'

mcqs.q: Mrs Alving and her son Oswald are characters in Ibsen's:
mcqs.exp: Ghosts (1881); pita ki bimari ka 'bhoot' bete par.

mcqs.q: In Chekhov's The Cherry Orchard, the estate is finally bought by:
mcqs.exp: Lopakhin, purane serf ka beta, orchard khareedta hai.

mcqs.q: Six Characters in Search of an Author (1921) was written by:
mcqs.exp: Italian dramatist Pirandello, metatheatre ka classic.

mcqs.q: The preface to which play is a famous manifesto of naturalist drama?
mcqs.exp: Strindberg ki Miss Julie (1888) ki preface.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is NOT part of Lorca's rural trilogy?
mcqs.exp: Trilogy = Blood Wedding, Yerma, The House of Bernarda Alba.

mcqs.q: Mrichchhakatika (The Little Clay Cart) is attributed to:
mcqs.exp: Shudraka; Charudatta aur Vasantasena ki kahani.

mcqs.q: The theory of rasa originates in:
mcqs.exp: Bharata Muni ka Natyashastra; rasa sutra wahin se.

mcqs.q: Tagore's play Dak Ghar is known in English as:
options: The King of the Dark Chamber
mcqs.exp: The Post Office; bimar bachcha Amal raja ki chitthi ka intezaar karta hai.

mcqs.q: The Second Shepherds' Play belongs to which English mystery cycle?
mcqs.exp: Wakefield Master ki rachna; Mak sheep chor.

mcqs.q: The original Marathi title of Tendulkar's Silence! The Court Is in Session is:
mcqs.exp: Shantata! Court Chalu Aahe (1967), Leela Benare.

mcqs.q: Badal Sircar's alternative, low-cost people's theatre is called:
mcqs.exp: Third Theatre: na proscenium na folk, seedha logon ke beech.

mcqs.q: The 'Theatre of Cruelty' was proposed by:
mcqs.exp: Artaud, The Theatre and Its Double (1938).

mcqs.q: Which is NOT one of the four kinds of theatre in Peter Brook's The Empty Space?
mcqs.exp: Brook: Deadly, Holy, Rough, Immediate. Epic Brecht ka hai.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Characters) with List II (Plays): (a) Sir Epicure Mammon (b) Sir Giles Overreach (c) Vindice (d) Beatrice-Joanna -- (i) The Revenger's Tragedy (ii) The Changeling (iii) The Alchemist (iv) A New Way to Pay Old Debts
mcqs.exp: Mammon-Alchemist (Jonson), Overreach-Massinger, Vindice-Revenger's Tragedy, Beatrice-Joanna-Changeling.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Plays) with List II (Dramatists): (a) The Rivals (b) The Beaux' Stratagem (c) The Relapse (d) The Conscious Lovers -- (i) George Farquhar (ii) Richard Steele (iii) John Vanbrugh (iv) R. B. Sheridan
mcqs.exp: Rivals-Sheridan, Beaux' Stratagem-Farquhar, Relapse-Vanbrugh, Conscious Lovers-Steele (sentimental comedy).

mcqs.q: Match List I (Plays) with List II (Dramatists): (a) The Iceman Cometh (b) Cat on a Hot Tin Roof (c) The Zoo Story (d) Fences -- (i) August Wilson (ii) Edward Albee (iii) Eugene O'Neill (iv) Tennessee Williams
mcqs.exp: Iceman-O'Neill, Cat-Williams, Zoo Story-Albee, Fences-August Wilson.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Plays) with List II (Dramatists): (a) Rhinoceros (b) The Maids (c) Endgame (d) Mother Courage and Her Children -- (i) Bertolt Brecht (ii) Samuel Beckett (iii) Jean Genet (iv) Eugene Ionesco
mcqs.exp: Rhinoceros-Ionesco, The Maids-Genet, Endgame-Beckett, Mother Courage-Brecht.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Characters) with List II (Plays): (a) Davies (b) Hamm (c) Archie Rice (d) Eliza Doolittle -- (i) Pygmalion (ii) The Entertainer (iii) Endgame (iv) The Caretaker
mcqs.exp: Davies-Caretaker (Pinter), Hamm-Endgame (Beckett), Archie Rice-Entertainer (Osborne), Eliza-Pygmalion (Shaw).

mcqs.q: Match List I (Plays) with List II (Dramatists): (a) Tara (b) Nagamandala (c) Kanyadaan (d) Andha Yug -- (i) Dharamvir Bharati (ii) Mahesh Dattani (iii) Girish Karnad (iv) Vijay Tendulkar
mcqs.exp: Tara-Dattani, Nagamandala-Karnad, Kanyadaan-Tendulkar, Andha Yug-Dharamvir Bharati.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Concepts) with List II (Theorists): (a) Theatre of Cruelty (b) Poor Theatre (c) Epic Theatre (d) Theatre of the Oppressed -- (i) Bertolt Brecht (ii) Augusto Boal (iii) Antonin Artaud (iv) Jerzy Grotowski
mcqs.exp: Cruelty-Artaud, Poor-Grotowski, Epic-Brecht, Oppressed-Boal.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Plays) with List II (Dramatists): (a) The Countess Cathleen (b) The Hostage (c) Translations (d) The Well of the Saints -- (i) Brian Friel (ii) J. M. Synge (iii) W. B. Yeats (iv) Brendan Behan
mcqs.exp: Countess Cathleen-Yeats, Hostage-Behan, Translations-Friel, Well of the Saints-Synge.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Plays) with List II (Dramatists): (a) The Bacchae (b) The Frogs (c) Thyestes (d) The Brothers (Adelphoe) -- (i) Terence (ii) Seneca (iii) Aristophanes (iv) Euripides
mcqs.exp: Bacchae-Euripides, Frogs-Aristophanes, Thyestes-Seneca, Adelphoe-Terence.

mcqs.q: Match List I (Critical works) with List II (Authors): (a) An Apology for Poetry (b) Preface to Shakespeare (c) The Quintessence of Ibsenism (d) The Death of Tragedy -- (i) George Steiner (ii) G. B. Shaw (iii) Samuel Johnson (iv) Philip Sidney
mcqs.exp: Apology-Sidney, Preface-Johnson (1765), Quintessence-Shaw (1891), Death of Tragedy-Steiner (1961).

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Women's roles on the Elizabethan public stage were played by boy actors. Reason (R): Women were not permitted to act on the professional English stage until the Restoration.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: 1660 ke baad hi actresses aayi, isliye pehle ladke female roles karte the.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Marlowe's Doctor Faustus is based on the German Faust legend as told in the Faustbuch. Reason (R): Marlowe also wrote The Jew of Malta.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Dono sach, par Jew of Malta likhna Faustus ke source ko explain nahi karta.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Ben Jonson's plays are known as comedies of humours. Reason (R): Jonson rejected the old idea that bodily humours shape human character.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: A sahi; R galat, Jonson ne humours theory ko hi apni comedy ka base banaya.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Beckett's Waiting for Godot was first written and staged in English. Reason (R): Beckett originally wrote it in French as En attendant Godot, staged in Paris in 1953.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Pehle French mein likha gaya, English version baad mein; isliye A galat, R sahi.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Brecht wanted spectators to watch critically rather than identify emotionally with the characters. Reason (R): He used the alienation effect to make the familiar look strange.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Alienation effect ka maqsad hi critical distance banana hai.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Wilde's The Importance of Being Earnest is a comedy of manners. Reason (R): Oscar Wilde was born in Dublin.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Dono sach, par Dublin mein janam se play comedy of manners nahi banta.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Ibsen's A Doll's House ends with Nora leaving her husband and children. Reason (R): Ibsen wrote A Doll's House in verse.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: A sahi (door slam); R galat, play prose mein hai.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Aristotle held that character is the soul of tragedy. Reason (R): In the Poetics Aristotle calls plot the first principle and the soul of tragedy.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Aristotle ke liye plot soul hai, character doosre number par. A galat, R sahi.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (a) The Duchess of Malfi (b) Gorboduc (c) The Way of the World (d) The Spanish Tragedy
mcqs.exp: Gorboduc 1561, Spanish Tragedy c. 1587, Duchess of Malfi c. 1613, Way of the World 1700.

mcqs.q: Arrange Shakespeare's plays in chronological order: (a) The Tempest (b) Romeo and Juliet (c) King Lear (d) Hamlet
mcqs.exp: Romeo c. 1595, Hamlet c. 1600, Lear c. 1605, Tempest c. 1611.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (a) She Stoops to Conquer (b) The Country Wife (c) The Beggar's Opera (d) The School for Scandal
mcqs.exp: Country Wife 1675, Beggar's Opera 1728, She Stoops 1773, School for Scandal 1777.

mcqs.q: Arrange Ibsen's plays in chronological order: (a) Hedda Gabler (b) Peer Gynt (c) A Doll's House (d) The Wild Duck
mcqs.exp: Peer Gynt 1867, Doll's House 1879, Wild Duck 1884, Hedda Gabler 1890.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (a) Death of a Salesman (b) A Streetcar Named Desire (c) The Hairy Ape (d) Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
mcqs.exp: Hairy Ape 1922, Streetcar 1947, Salesman 1949, Virginia Woolf 1962.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (a) The Birthday Party (b) Murder in the Cathedral (c) Arcadia (d) Saved
mcqs.exp: Murder in the Cathedral 1935, Birthday Party 1958, Saved (Bond) 1965, Arcadia (Stoppard) 1993.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (a) Tughlaq (b) The Post Office (c) Hayavadana (d) Tara
mcqs.exp: Post Office 1912, Tughlaq 1964, Hayavadana 1971, Tara 1990s.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Ralph Roister Doister was written by John Lyly.
Gorboduc was written by Thomas Sackville and Thomas Norton.
Tamburlaine was written by Robert Greene.
mcqs.exp: Gorboduc: Sackville-Norton (1561). Ralph Roister Doister Udall ka, Everyman morality play, Tamburlaine Marlowe ka.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Philip Massinger wrote The White Devil.
John Ford wrote The Broken Heart.
mcqs.exp: Ford - The Broken Heart. Changeling Middleton-Rowley, Alchemist Jonson, White Devil Webster.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Shelagh Delaney wrote A Taste of Honey.
John Arden wrote Look Back in Anger.
mcqs.exp: Delaney - A Taste of Honey (1958). Look Back Osborne, Saved Bond, Top Girls Churchill.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: David Mamet wrote Angels in America.
August Wilson wrote Glengarry Glen Ross.
mcqs.exp: Shepard - True West. Angels Kushner, Glengarry Mamet, Fences August Wilson.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: The Theatre and Its Double was written by Brecht.
Aristotle's Poetics deals mainly with lyric poetry.
Dryden's An Essay of Dramatic Poesy is a dialogue among five speakers.
Martin Esslin's The Theatre of the Absurd was first published in 1961.
mcqs.exp: Esslin 1961. Theatre and Its Double Artaud ka, Poetics tragedy/epic par, Dryden mein 4 speakers.
